evidence:
Hash check: all 37 task and 34 rules hashes in manifest.json match the frozen cache; all 10 raw-evidence-index entries match their sha256 and frozen source hashes. The index's own scope states full configured grading is absent, so this is a source-level review; no judge run exercised coverage.

Requirement -> criterion map (brief = instruction.md plus the notes it delegates to). Coverage is broad and I found it complete for almost everything:
- instruction.md:1 netted exchange, saved preview, all-or-none commit -> hro_change_net_budget, hro_change_preview, hro_change_preview_durable/_neutral, hro_change_stale_leaf, hro_change_lineage.
- instruction.md:3 out-of-date preview incl. restored balance -> hro_change_aba, hro_change_stale_leaf, hro_change_noninvalidating; lost-response retry and original receipt after later changes/restart -> hro_pol_uncertain_commit, hro_change_retry_concurrent, hro_change_retry_later, hro_change_retry_restart.
- instruction.md:5 underlying desk -> hro_intrinsic/annual/runrate/basis/bands, tier and role matrices, hro_dual, hro_approval_budget, hro_commitment, hro_grant, hro_signing, hro_referral_*, hro_revision_*, hro_release/claw/cancel, hro_months, caps, hro_history, hro_afterimage*, hro_audit_*; six views -> app_context.md:20, gate render, anon-read families, visual prompt.md:14.
- instruction.md:7 pre-save figures and overrun warning -> hro_desk_figures; add/drop 2-4 incl. middle -> hro_desk_remove_member; which hire/which field -> hro_desk_field_refusal.
- instruction.md:9 15-second live updates -> hro_live_stale_mark, hro_live_committed_viewer, hro_live_source_flag; typing/cursor/scroll undisturbed -> hro_pol_live_keeps_entries; unsent entries across view switch/reload -> hro_entries_reload; ended session, resume, privacy from another person -> hro_pol_session_resume.
- instruction.md:11 what-if for other roles, nothing left behind -> hro_whatif_roles plus hro_change_prepare_*/commit_* 403 rows.
- instruction.md:13 retained revision terms, retained rescission date, clear explanation -> hro_keep_revision_terms, hro_keep_rescission_date, hro_pol_change_recovery, hro_pol_focus (rules section 12 Focus).
- instruction.md:15-19 runtime, seed-once, restart retention, accounts -> test.sh launch/liveness, hro_gate_shared, hro_restart, hro_referrer_roster; all seven accounts are exercised by role rows.
- rules sections 2-9 and 11 line by line (validation, dates, DRAFT, relocation exclusion, competing headroom, concurrency, 401/403, operation key, receipts, post-transfer anchors) each have an owning row.

GAP 1 (the Fail): hireops_rules.md:426 states "Finance can prepare a change set containing two through four distinct current COMMITTED offers" and :529 repeats that an editor member must be the current COMMITTED offer. No criterion ever offers an ineligible source at prepare. hro_change_shape (functional/judge.toml:1001) enumerates only "One/five members, repeated source, missing/nonexistent destination and missing/blank operation key"; B2 (functional/prompt.md:65) lists the same set. hro_change_stale_leaf (judge.toml:1019) only covers a source that was COMMITTED at preview and superseded afterwards. A PENDING, DRAFT, RESCINDED or already-SUPERSEDED offer chosen as a member is never tried. The golden does enforce it (solution/app/src/change-sets.js:72 and :125 storedOffer(..., 'COMMITTED')), so the reference treats it as a rule, yet it is ungraded.

Other gaps, reported as required but not blocking on their own:
- GAP 2 (Note, unobservable): rules :430-431 "only the Finance actor who prepared a change set may commit it" and :434 "The key belongs to that signed-in actor" cannot be exercised because the roster has one Finance account; functional/prompt.md:71 says so explicitly. Honest limitation, still ungraded.
- GAP 3 (P3, sampling): rules :539 "Every signed-in role can use the editor"; hro_whatif_roles (judge.toml:1361) samples Auditor and Recruiter only. Comp partner and the three approvers are never shown the editor or its figures (hro_change_readers covers reading saved previews, not the what-if). Likewise privacy of unsent entries is sampled with Recruiter only.
- GAP 4 (P3): rules :299 referral cliff dates use the month-end clamp convention; hro_referral_clock's witnesses (Feb 1 and Jan 31 12:00 -> Jul 31) never need a clamp, so a non-clamping referral cliff passes. Signing/equity clamp is covered by hro_months.
- Not counted as gaps: Node/Express/SQLite, no package install, no external data service and health-without-database (instruction.md:15) are not browser-decidable; REVIEW_POLICY 'Coverage has two directions' says a browser exchange cannot prove them, and test.sh plus hro_gate_shared/hro_restart cover the observable part. Bundled flows (e.g. P4 chain rows) are the documented false positive and were not flagged.
counterexample: Weak app that passes: a change desk whose prepare accepts any existing offer id as a member and whose commit only compares each source's state with the state captured at preview (a literal reading of 'captures the exact current source leaves'). Finance selects a PENDING offer, with or without another member, saves the preview and commits: the PENDING offer gains a COMMITTED successor with a budget commitment, grant and signing payment, with no approver, no tier check and no dual control. The same app could re-commit a RESCINDED hire. Every functional, polish and visual criterion still passes, because all B/D/L protocols build members only from approved hires and hro_change_stale_leaf uses a source that changed after preview. Conforming alternative that could fail on this row's account: none found; I found no criterion that fails a conforming app through a coverage hole.
suggested_fix: Add an ineligible-source leg graded after a valid control: with one current COMMITTED member, a second member that is PENDING and, separately, one that is RESCINDED must not yield a saved valid preview or any economic effect (replay of the observed prepare request if the editor does not list such offers). Put it in a small separate criterion or in hro_change_shape and name it in B2; reuse P1/P4 records so workload barely changes. Optionally extend hro_whatif_roles to one approver and add a clamping referral witness (start Aug 31 -> cliff Feb 28).
